onboarding.welcomeDesc: Your clipboard history, on a shelf at the edge of your screen. Move your pointer to the edge to open it.
onboarding.collectDesc: Copy with Ctrl+C as usual. Every text, link, image and file you copy is saved to the shelf.
onboarding.dropInDesc: Drag files, links, images or text onto the screen edge. Files dropped together become one stack.
onboarding.dragDesc: Drag any card from the shelf into an app, a folder or a document to use it there.
onboarding.stacksDesc: Drag a file out of a stack onto the edge light to make it a card. Drop a card on a stack to add it.
onboarding.previewDesc: The preview button on a card opens it full size, including every file in a stack.
onboarding.findDesc: Right-click a card and choose Add note. Search finds any card by its text, file names or note.
onboarding.configDesc: Put the shelf on the left, top or right edge of your screen. You can change it any time in Settings.
onboarding.dropToExtract: Drop to extract back into a standalone card
onboarding.proTip1: Press Alt + C to instantly toggle the shelf.
onboarding.proTip2: Access settings anytime via the gear icon (top right).
onboarding.proTip3: Drag & drop files to the left edge to add them.
onboarding.proTip4: Click a text box, then a clipboard item to auto-paste.
onboarding.ungroupDesc: Want to separate items in a stack? Click to expand the stack, then drag any subitem to the left edge of the screen. A glowing coral bar will appear—drop the item on it to extract it back into a standalone card.
onboarding.mergeDesc: Combine separate file or image cards by dragging them directly onto each other. This organizes your shelf by bundling related assets into a stack.
onboarding.backupDesc: Export your clipboard history, pinned items, and settings into an encrypted .txa archive. Seamlessly transfer to a new PC or restore anytime with Merge or Overwrite modes.

themeStudio.title: Theme & Color Mode
themeStudio.desc: Live animated preview to pick your shelf theme and color mode.
themeStudio.cardDesc: Live animated preview to pick your shelf theme and color mode.

whatsNew.mdDesc: Expanding a Markdown card renders a clean formatted preview (headings, tables, code blocks) instead of raw syntax. Click the pencil button to edit any copied text card right in place.
whatsNew.mdTip: Tip: Press Ctrl+Enter to save fast, or toggle Preview / Raw anytime.
whatsNew.mpDesc: Click Pin in the header to keep the shelf open while working. Ctrl+Click multiple text cards in order to copy or paste them all combined in one go.
whatsNew.mpTip: Tip: Pick newline (↵), paragraph (¶), or space (␣) separator right on the floating bar.
whatsNew.thDesc: Keeps the signature Obsidian dark theme as default, plus 10 curated themes, your own accent color, corner styles and System / Light / Dark modes with a live preview in Settings → Appearance.
whatsNew.thTip: Tip: Choose "System" to automatically follow your Windows theme.
whatsNew.afDesc: Skip copies from apps you never want saved, like password managers, or record only the apps you pick.
whatsNew.afTip: Tip: Settings → Behaviour → Include / Exclude Apps. Quick presets cover KeePass, Bitwarden and 1Password.
whatsNew.v37FocusDesc: Fixed keyboard focus dropping while typing in the shelf and fixed not being able to click or type into the App Filter input in Settings. Typing now stays steady without losing focus.
whatsNew.v37FocusTip: Tip: Click the App Filter box or inline editor and start typing right away.
whatsNew.v37LightDesc: Fixed text and button contrast across Light Mode (header, search bar, cards, menus, and settings), and added 5 new themes (11 total), custom accent color, and corner styles.
whatsNew.v37LightTip: Tip: Open Settings → Appearance to try Light/Dark mode, accents, and corner styles.
whatsNew.v37StabDesc: Rapid back-to-back copies are no longer dropped while a previous read is still finishing. Sound effects now pause safely when a headset is unplugged instead of retrying nonstop.
whatsNew.v37StabTip: Tip: Sound effects automatically resume after 15 seconds once your audio device is ready.
whatsNew.v37StabCopy: Keeps every copy during rapid back-to-back copies
whatsNew.v37StabAudio: Pauses audio safely on headset unplug or device error
whatsNew.v37CleanDesc: Added 48 hours, 72 hours, 7 days, 14 days, and 30 days options to the Clear menu across all 31 languages, alongside a redesigned Donate modal.
whatsNew.v37CleanTip: Tip: Open the Clear menu at the bottom of the shelf to pick your preferred range.
